title: The Sun is a star
examples: Teacher, is the Sun a planet?
How far away is the Sun from Earth?
Why is the Sun so hot?

explain.say: The Sun is the star closest to Earth.
The Sun gives us light and heat.
The Sun is very hot and very bright.
Never look straight at the Sun. It can hurt your eyes.

items: Never look straight at the Sun
Look away to keep your eyes safe

explain.say: A common mistake is to think the Sun is a lamp. It is a huge star made of hot gas.

draw.text: The Sun is a star, not a lamp

faq.a: No, the Sun is a star. Stars are giant balls of hot gas that make their own light and heat.
asks: What is the Sun made of?

faq.q: How far away is the Sun?
faq.a: The Sun is about 150 million kilometres away. That is very far, but it is still the closest star to us.
Deep inside the Sun, tiny parts squeeze together. This makes huge amounts of heat and light.

faq.q: Can I look at the Sun with my bare eyes?
faq.a: No. Never look straight at the Sun. It is too bright and can hurt your eyes.
asks: Is it safe to look at the Sun?
What should I use to see the Sun?

faq.a: A star is a huge ball of very hot gas that shines. Our Sun is the star we live near.
asks: Are all stars like the Sun?
What is the difference between a star and a planet?

facts: It is the star closest to Earth.
It provides us with light and heat.
It is very bright and hot.

quiz.say: What kind of thing is the Sun?
quiz.why: The Sun makes its own light and heat, so it is a star.

wrong.1: A planet like Earth goes around the Sun and makes no light.
wrong.2: A moon goes around a planet and makes no light of its own.

quiz.say: The Sun is very bright. What should you do?
quiz.why: Looking away keeps your eyes safe. Never look straight at the Sun.

wrong.0: Staring at the Sun can hurt your eyes.
wrong.1: Sunglasses are too weak to make it safe to look at the Sun.

quiz.say: What do plants get from the Sun to help them grow?
quiz.why: Plants use sunlight to make their food.

wrong.0: Rain comes from clouds, and plants need it too.
wrong.2: Soil is in the ground, and plants grow their roots in it.
